title: TCTOrbitPrivacyShieldConfig
description: Configuration schema mapping every TCT Orbit Privacy & Shield toggle to Electron session APIs, Chromium switches, preload hardening patches, and storage keys.

adBlockerEnabled.title: Ad & Content Blocker
adBlockerEnabled.description: Blocks YouTube video ads, sponsored banners, popups, and intrusive ad slots via EasyList, EasyPrivacy, and AdGuard engine.

implementation.networkInterceptor: session.webRequest.onBeforeRequest (blocking doubleclick, googleadservices, googlesyndication, youtube ad_break)
implementation.preloadScript: Cosmetic DOM ad suppression & YouTube video ad auto-skipper

trackerProtection.title: Strict Tracker & Bounce Protection
trackerProtection.description: Intercepts tracking beacons, analytics telemetry, and intermediate redirect hops.

fingerprintResistance.title: Browser Fingerprinting Resistance
fingerprintResistance.description: Injects subtle canvas/audio noise and normalizes hardware concurrency, memory & sensor APIs.

httpsOnlyMode.title: HTTPS-Only Mode
httpsOnlyMode.description: Automatically upgrades all unencrypted HTTP connections to encrypted HTTPS.

dnsOverHttps.title: DNS over HTTPS (DoH)
dnsOverHttps.description: Encrypts domain name queries with zero unencrypted fallback (prevents ISP snooping).

webrtcProtection.title: WebRTC IP Leak Protection
webrtcProtection.description: Disables non-proxied UDP to prevent websites from discovering your real public/local IP via WebRTC.

globalPrivacyControl.title: Global Privacy Control (GPC) & DNT
globalPrivacyControl.description: Sends Sec-GPC: 1 and DNT: 1 headers signaling visited sites not to track or sell your data.

stripTrackingParams.title: Strip Tracking Query Parameters
stripTrackingParams.description: Removes tracking identifiers (utm_*, fbclid, gclid, mc_eid) from all navigation links.

implementation.electronApi: session.webRequest.onBeforeRequest (strip searchParams matching TRACKING_QUERY_PARAMS and redirectURL)

blockThirdPartyCookies.title: Block Third-Party Cookies & State Isolation
blockThirdPartyCookies.description: Isolates storage and prevents cross-site tracking cookies across different websites.

clearCacheOnExit.title: Clear Browsing Data on Exit
clearCacheOnExit.description: Automatically clears cookies, cache, and visited site storage when closing the browser.

whitelistedOrigins.title: Per-Site Shield Whitelist
whitelistedOrigins.description: List of origins for which ad and tracker protection is temporarily paused.
